headline: Democrat Chuck Hubbard Defeats Republican Virginia Foxx In House Race
seoTitle: Chuck Hubbard Defeats Virginia Foxx in North Carolina
metaDescription: Democrat Chuck Hubbard secured a House victory in North Carolina following a recount, defeating Republican Virginia Foxx to expand the Democratic majority.
aiSummaryBullets: Democrat Chuck Hubbard won a seat in the US House of Representatives following a recount in North Carolina.
The victory involved defeating Republican Virginia Foxx, who is the chair of the House Rules Committee.
This result contributes to a Democratic majority of at least 258 seats in the 2026 US midterm elections.
aiContextParagraph: The 2026 United States midterm elections have resulted in a notable shift in the composition of the House of Representatives. Following a recount in North Carolina, Democrat Chuck Hubbard emerged as the victor against long-serving Republican representative Virginia Foxx. As the current chair of the House Rules Committee, Foxx's loss represents a significant change in congressional leadership. According to projections, this win is part of a broader electoral trend that has granted Democrats a significant majority, reaching at least 258 seats for the upcoming session. This outcome is described as the party's most successful general election performance in several decades. The confirmation of Hubbard's victory concludes the recount process in the district, finalizing the balance of power as legislative preparations begin for the next term in Washington.
whyItIsViral: The story is being tracked by two independent news organizations and has generated moderate viral activity as election results are finalized.
